A
Just a Guy
Jan 4, 2020 #2

Hi D and welcome to the interledger community! Yes, there is a possible economic incentive-- connectors can charge a spread on the transactions they facilitate. There’s a variable called CONNECTOR_SPREAD that can be set by the connector operator (https://github.com/interledgerjs/ilp-connector/blob/master/README.md#spread)

Users of ILP however may be incentivized to select connectors offering the lowest spread, so connectors offering the same pairs will need to compete amongst each other.
